sentences.en: Juha wanted to travel and leave the house.

sentences.ar: أمه قالت له: دير بالك عالباب.
sentences.en: His mother said to him: take care of the door.

sentences.ar: جحا قلع الباب وحمله على ظهره.
sentences.en: Juha took the door off and carried it on his back.
He walked with it the whole way.
People asked him: why are you carrying the door?

sentences.ar: قال: أمي قالت لي دير بالك عليه.
sentences.en: He said: my mother told me to take care of it.
